description: AI Integration - Mount existing ListingAssistant and DemandInsights components into CreateListing and Dashboard pages, verify AI API routes are properly connected
steps: Mount ListingAssistant component in client/src/pages/restaurant/CreateListing.jsx with onApplyResult callback that fills foodName, category, description form fields
Mount DemandInsights component in client/src/pages/restaurant/Dashboard.jsx below existing stats cards
Verify /api/ai routes are wired in server/src/app.js - confirm aiRoutes.js is imported and mounted at /api/ai path
Test AI endpoints return mock data: GET /api/ai/listing-suggestions and GET /api/ai/demand-insights

Restaurant dashboard shows demand insights charts and recommendations section

Check restaurant dashboard displays demand insights section
